content: {"summary":"Customers are frustrated that seat changes during upgrades move them away from preferred seats, often without clear explanations, leading to disappointment and a sense of unfair treatment [tk_2379113][tk_519951][tk_536127]. Many users report that the system pre‑selects seats automatically, preventing manual selection and causing them to lose window or aisle seats they value [tk_536127]. Confusion also arises when upgrades separate families or friends who booked together, with no option to keep adjacent seating [tk_132695]. Additionally, some passengers cannot assign seats after purchase, hindering their ability to sit with companions [tk_2666140]."}
